The Tax Foundation argued recently that we should think of the falling labor share as making a 'round trip' back to 'historically precedented' values.

I disagree and walk through how the argument is weaker than it seems. Plus we dig into NIPA flat files! newsletter.mikekonczal.com/p/i-disagree...
